'''Gwil Nermasiv''' is the brother of [[Areina Nermasiv]].

== History ==
Gwil was a young man from [[Kandor]] who went to [[Illian (city)|Illian]] to take the oath of a [[Hunter of the Horn]]. 

His sister Areina followed him to take him home, but did not find him, and eventually took the Hunter's oath herself.{{ref/book|5|49}}
